name: Warminster YMCA Summer Camp
description_short: Half day and full day specialty camps at the Warminster YMCA: Metro Esports with gym games, swimming and STEAM for grades K to 7, plus NinjaZone and gymnastics mornings and AquaBucks swim afternoons for grades K to 5.
notes: Summer 2027 runs June 14 to August 20, 2027; AquaBucks swim camp weekly June 21 to August 20, 12:30 to 3:30 pm; Campers Create art camp July 12 to 16, 9 am to noon. Half day 9 am to noon or 12:30 to 3:30 pm; full day 9 am to 4 pm, with lunch from noon to 1 pm to join an AM and PM camp. Esports runs grades 2 to 7 per the at a glance box and K to 7 per the intro. Free pizza Fridays for full time campers. A 2027 summer membership (youth $86) gives member camp pricing. The YMCA also runs a separate camp at Warminster Park. Weekly 2027 prices not posted yet.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Warminster branch camp page: 2027 season, programs by grade, hours, air conditioned indoor spaces, financial assistance. Ages derived from grades K to 7 (age_min = grade_min + 5, age_max = grade_max + 6).
